Full body side-view Street Fighter character sprite facing right, Mid roundhouse kick. One leg is raised and COMPLETELY straight out to the side at hip height, foot reaching far beyond the body. Supporting leg planted straight, arms out for balance. Leg fully extended, not bent, not standing. Full body from head to toe, both feet visible and planted on the ground, entire figure inside the frame with generous empty margin on all sides, no cropping, camera far back, whole body shot..
Satirical arcade boss caricature of MARK CARNEY: tall lean-athletic build (less bulky than the opponent); grey hair in a normal short neat side-parted cut; fair skin, laughing open-mouth grin; dark charcoal or black business suit; white dress shirt; light sky-blue necktie; black dress shoes; clenched-fist fighting stance, one fist forward.
Chunky 16-bit SNES fighter proportions, oversized readable silhouette, thick dark outline, flat cel shading, limited saturated palette, head to toe visible, centered with padding.
Solid flat magenta background #FF00FF, no floor, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no photo.
